blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) has denied the accreditation applications of two motorcycle taxi platform providers (MTPPs) for failing to comply with some of the agency’s requirements. Lawyer Greg Pua, interim chair of the LTFRB, said a review of GrabBike and Dingdong RiderKo’s operations revealed that they had failed to meet some conditions within the period given to them. The two MTPPs were earlier granted authority to operate during their pilot implementation in Metro Manila and nearby areas, as well as in other urban areas across the Philippines, the LTFRB said.
